response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM k

assumptions.assumption: The 'average share' is the plain average of per-group shares across all groups (non-null ID), which equals 1/number of groups. Kept groups are those with share strictly greater than it.
Examination records are counted as rows in Examination; groups need not exist in Patient.
